With spot ($7403.67) trapped between the put wall ($7400) and call wall ($7450), and intraday accuracy historically poor (30.8%), the baseline is NEUTRAL. The CAG indicates a BULL-DELUDED crowd, providing a slight contrarian bullish tilt for the next-day and 30-day horizons, aligned with the 74% monthly base rate. Targets are widened by 1.5x to account for the undershoot bias and dealer flow amplification.
